summary: Design and evaluate control under bounded uncertainty rather than only the single nominal dynamics model.
outcomes: Separate model uncertainty, disturbances and measurement noise
Compare nominal performance with worst-case guarantees under a stated uncertainty set
sequence: Define a nominal system and uncertain parameter range
Inspect a robust stability or gain condition on a small system
Trade nominal speed against robustness and actuator limits

visual.question: Does the best nominal controller remain acceptable at the edge of the allowed model set?
visual.interaction: Sweep uncertain parameters while retaining the same control policy

practice.task: Compare nominal and robust designs in a small simulation
practice.success: Worst-case claims specify the uncertainty set and are distinguished from finite sampled tests
